notes.title: Ver1.003
notes.content: Removed items that were too strong. I can no longer come out while playing.

notes.title: Ver1.002
notes.content:
Price adjustment in the shop
Reduced waiting time during NowLoading
Adjusted the level calculation from using points spent to focusing on total points acquired
Fixed an issue where, on rare occasions, the respawn location would move to a different place than other players when moving between ROUNDS
